name: Grave Dagger
description: Dagger implicit: 25% chance on hit to apply 1 stacking Corruption; +25% Critical Strike Chance.
flavour: Quick, jealous, and fond of opening veins.

name: Chipped Warbound Blade
description: Starter sword: one socket, one clean single-target swing. Every third swing still grants +10% Attack Speed for 3s.
flavour: It remembers the hand that first lifted it. That is all it remembers.

name: Cracked Riftwood Staff
description: Starter staff: one socket, slow heavy swings that extend ailment timers and restore 2% ward per hit. Spans the Offhand.
flavour: The crack in the wood is where the spell got out.

name: Rusted Grave Dagger
description: Starter dagger: 25% chance on hit to apply a stacking Corruption, +20% Critical Strike Chance, fastest swing in the game.
flavour: Fast hands. Faster rot.

name: Iron Broadsword
description: Sword implicit: Every 3rd swing cleaves up to 3 enemies at 60% damage and grants +10% Attack Speed for 3s.
flavour: Every third swing remembers the field it fell on.

name: Warbound Greatsword
description: Two-Handed Sword implicit: Every 3rd swing cleaves up to 3 enemies at 60% damage and grants +10% Attack Speed for 3s. Spans Offhand.
flavour: Two hands, one argument.

name: Iron Mace
description: Mace implicit: 30% chance on hit to Daze the target (-20% enemy attack speed & damage for 3s).
flavour: Dazed is a kind word for it.

name: Siege Maul
description: Two-Handed Mace implicit: 30% chance on hit to Daze the target (-20% enemy attack speed & damage for 3s). Spans Offhand.
flavour: Built to disagree with walls.

name: Flaying Axe
description: Axe implicit: Inflicts Bleed on critical strikes and deals +25% damage to Bleeding targets.
flavour: It only ever asks for a little more.

name: Headsman's Axe
description: Two-Handed Axe implicit: Inflicts Bleed on critical strikes and deals +25% damage to Bleeding targets. Spans Offhand.
flavour: Bleed first. Ask afterwards.

name: Warbound Longbow
description: Bow implicit: +20% Double-Hit Chance and restores 3% Max Mana on critical strikes. Spans Offhand.
flavour: The string is a tendon. Nobody asks whose.

name: Riftwood Staff
description: Staff implicit: Refreshes 1.0s of active DoTs on hit and restores 2% Max Ward per swing. Spans Offhand.
flavour: The grain runs in two directions at once.

name: Bastion Shield
description: Offhand Shield providing heavy Armor and flat Max Ward for defensive builds.
flavour: A wall you can carry.

name: Ward Focus
description: Caster Offhand granting Max Mana and Max Ward to sustain spell rotations.
flavour: It holds a little of every ward that failed.

name: Hooded Cowl
description: Light Warbound headgear woven to reinforce Max Ward.
flavour: No face beneath it. Only intent.

name: Riveted Helm
description: Plated helm providing dependable baseline Armor and up to 4 universal sockets.
flavour: The dents are a service record.

name: Warbound Cuirass
description: Core Warbound breastplate granting Max Health and up to 6 universal sockets for primary skill links.
flavour: The soul-spark burns where a heart should sit.

name: Grip of the Fallen
description: Armored gauntlets sharpening Critical Strike precision.
flavour: They grip what the living let go.

name: Gravewalker Leggings
description: Greaves anchored with Fortitude to bolster Health, Regen, Armor, and Thorns.
flavour: Mud to the knee, always.

name: Silent Treads
description: Evasive boots boosting entropy-assisted Dodge Rating.
flavour: They make no sound on ash or snow.

name: Soulglass Pendant
description: Focuses Wisdom to expand Mana, Cast Speed, Ward, and Ailment Potency.
flavour: A spark, suspended. Not yours.

name: Emberchain
description: Woven iron collar granting baseline Fire Resistance.
flavour: Warm to the touch, even in the frozen cathedral.

name: Cinder Band
description: Ring slot (Left or Right) providing Fire Resistance and a utility socket.
flavour: Set with a coal that refuses to die.

name: Rime Band
description: Ring slot (Left or Right) providing Frost Resistance and a utility socket.
flavour: Cold enough to still a heartbeat.

name: Hourglass of the Sixth Bar
uniqueEffect: Every fifth second, both skill bars are considered active.
description: Unique Trinket: Accelerates Attack Speed and bridges Bar I and Bar II every 5th second.
flavour: The sand runs upward when nobody watches.

name: Hourglass of Waning Sands
uniqueEffect: Cooldowns recover 10% faster while below 35% health.
description: Unique Trinket: Speeds Cooldown Recovery and adds emergency CDR below 35% Health.
flavour: It keeps time with something other than you.

name: Soulvessel Charm
uniqueEffect: Killing an elite restores 6% of maximum health and ward.
description: Unique Trinket: Grants Life Leech and restores 6% Max Health & Ward when an elite falls.
flavour: A thimble for the soul. Never quite full.

name: Grave-Willow Wand
description: One-handed caster weapon. Fast Wisdom scaling and three sockets biased to Sapphire.
flavour: Cut from a willow that grew through a gravestone.

name: Paired Bone Dagger
description: Off-hand dagger: no block, but three Agility-biased sockets and a crit implicit.
flavour: The second blade is the honest one.

name: Ashwood Quiver
description: Off-hand quiver. Adds a projectile and rolls Emerald-leaning sockets.
flavour: The arrows are gone. The quiver still counts them.
